texts: When does a Keeper repeat the phrase?

fields.sentence: When does a Keeper repeat the phrase?

review.notes: "When?" binds the open (Time $e $t) as the Time-questions rule prescribes, with no status atom for the habitual present, the capitalized common noun "Keeper" bound by kind and the definite "the phrase" bound by its kind. "repeat" takes Theme, which is the outcome of the does-the-object-change test (and its stated default).
